title: Seedream 5.5
description: ByteDance Seedream 5.5 — more natural light, materials and skin, sharper small and dense text, and edits that leave everything you did not ask to change as it was. Text-to-image, instruction editing and multi-reference composition from up to 10 reference images, 1K or 2K output, and transparent backgrounds from a text prompt or a reference. Billing: 26 credits per image at 1K, 46 at 2K, plus 10 per reference image (each one, per generated image). No grouped/sequential generation.
pricing_text: Pricing: 46 credits per generation (varies by resolution).

background.description: Output background. "transparent" returns a cut-out PNG with an alpha channel, from a text prompt alone or from reference images (a transparent request is always a PNG).

output_format.description: Output image format. A transparent background is always a PNG.

prompt.description: Text description of the image to generate. Write `@handle` to cast a character: a BudgetPixel AI influencer or one of your own ([`GET /v1/characters`](/api-reference/characters/list-characters-you-can-cast)).

reference_images.description: Optional reference images (up to 10) for image editing and multi-reference composition. Each item is a public image URL, a data URI, raw base64, or an uploaded-file URL from POST /v1/uploads. Omit for text-to-image. Each reference image bills 10 credits per generated image. With aspect_ratio "match_input_image" an edit keeps its input's shape.

size.description: Output resolution. 1K bills 26 credits per image; 2K bills 46.
